name: How long does a typical flat roof replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flat roof replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flat roof replacement project depends on several factors, including the size and complexity of the roof, weather conditions, and the chosen roofing system. Generally, a residential flat roof replacement can take anywhere from a few days to a week. Commercial projects may take longer. Our team will provide a more accurate timeline after a thorough inspection of your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical residential flat roof replacement can take a few days to a week, depending on size and complexity.
